findings.evidenceJa: 帰ってきたかひょうろく玉
findings.governingReading: so you are home, you simpleton
findings.explanation: The English adds that Shirou’s return is late or long-awaited.

findings.evidenceJa: 打ちひしがれた負け犬の目
findings.governingReading: has the eyes of a crushed, defeated dog
findings.explanation: The comic animal image in Taiga’s expression disappears.

findings.highlight: I don’t think we need to worry about anything happening there
findings.evidenceJa: 見て回るべき対象から外していい
findings.governingReading: we can remove the school from the places we need to patrol
findings.explanation: A provisional operational decision becomes a broad claim that nothing there merits concern.

findings.evidenceJa: 昼間っから出来上がってる
findings.governingReading: she is already acting fully drunk in the middle of the day
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic comparison to daytime intoxication is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 悔しかったのか怖かったのか
findings.governingReading: whether she was terribly frustrated or frightened
findings.explanation: Two tentative possible causes become a definitive description of the experience.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーにブーイングを繰り出した
findings.governingReading: she launches boos at Saber
findings.explanation: Taiga’s noisy, childish protest is replaced by a silent hostile look.

findings.evidenceJa: 大事は起きません
findings.governingReading: nothing serious would happen
findings.explanation: Saber’s broader safety judgment is narrowed specifically to death.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーとは質が違う
findings.governingReading: her skill is of a different kind from Saber’s
findings.explanation: A qualitative difference between their abilities becomes a simple power ranking.

findings.highlight: You’ll see hell if you make a move on her! It’ll be your own fault if you die
findings.evidenceJa: 地獄開幕、死して屍拾うものなし
findings.governingReading: hell will open, and if you die no one will gather your corpse
findings.explanation: The theatrical stock formula about an unrecovered corpse becomes moral blame for Shirou’s death.

findings.highlight: If I sleep in the same room as someone like herIt’d be a problem
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーみたいな子と同じ部屋で寝るなんて正直困る
findings.governingReading: honestly, sleeping in the same room as a girl like Saber would be a problem
findings.explanation: The classic branch joins two clauses without punctuation and visibly breaks the sentence.

findings.evidenceJa: 正直困る
findings.governingReading: would honestly put me in a difficult position
findings.explanation: Shirou’s embarrassment is changed into uncertainty about unspecified events.

findings.evidenceJa: 私からシロウに手を上げる事は、決して
findings.governingReading: I would never raise a hand against Shirou of my own accord
findings.explanation: Saber’s assurance that she will not initiate violence is reversed into refusing retaliation.

findings.highlight: I will be sleeping in the same room as Shirou tonight
findings.evidenceJa: 今晩よりシロウと同室で眠ります
findings.governingReading: from tonight onward I will sleep in the same room as Shirou
findings.explanation: The continuing arrangement is reduced to one night.

findings.highlight: Saber states it as a matter of course
findings.governingReading: Taiga falls silent before freezing
findings.explanation: The English inserts source-free narration characterizing Saber’s delivery.

findings.evidenceJa: 背後の藤ねえに声をかける
findings.governingReading: I address Fuji-nee behind me
findings.explanation: An unsupported conciliatory motive is added to Shirou’s address.

findings.highlight: sounds of her stacking something like telephone books
findings.evidenceJa: 電話帳を重ねて台にするような物音
findings.governingReading: a sound like telephone books being stacked into a platform
findings.explanation: The platform function and the fact that the sound is comparative are blurred.

findings.evidenceJa: はいってる！　きまってる
findings.governingReading: the hold is sunk in—it is locked
findings.explanation: Shirou’s urgent grappling assessment is reduced to generic effectiveness.

findings.evidenceJa: 骨と肉の軋み
findings.governingReading: bones and flesh creaking
findings.explanation: The grotesque bodily detail of flesh straining with bone is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: ほぼ直角に落とされ
findings.governingReading: dropped at nearly a right angle
findings.explanation: The extreme geometry of Taiga’s throw is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: ひねってからは手を離して
findings.governingReading: let go after the twist
findings.explanation: The dangerous twisting phase preceding Taiga’s planned release disappears.

findings.highlight: Don’t try throwing me with those thin arms
findings.evidenceJa: 細腕でジャーマンなんかやんな
findings.governingReading: do not try a German suplex with those thin arms
findings.explanation: The named wrestling technique is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえも自爆してた
findings.governingReading: you might have taken yourself out too
findings.explanation: The risk of Taiga injuring herself through her own move is weakened to falling alongside Shirou.

findings.highlight: someone got injured, so I left Mitsuzuri-san in charge, took the person home
findings.evidenceJa: 怪我人がでちゃってね。後は美綴さんに任せて、体調悪い子たちを家まで送って
findings.governingReading: someone was injured; I left the rest to Mitsuzuri and escorted the unwell students to their homes
findings.explanation: Multiple sick students are collapsed into the single injured person, changing both count and condition.
